reason: In testsuite/integration-arquillian/tests/base/src/test/java/org/keycloak/testsuite/organization/cache/OrganizationCacheTest.java:300-303, testCacheIDPByOrg creates IDPs using the local variable alias but registers cleanup with the hardcoded string "alias", leaving 10 enabled IDPs leaked as realm-level providers after organization cleanup. Although line 303 predates this patch, adding testCacheIDPForLogin (lines 370-410) in the same test class sharing the test realm exposes this leak because its FetchMode.REALM_ONLY and FetchMode.ALL count assertions fail if testCacheIDPByOrg runs first.
